body: Fresh cross-check: Soitec is also locking customers into multi-year, deposit-backed photonics-SOI wafer deals as AI-optics demand rises. Para sa trend, interesting ito in two directions: it confirms na lumalawak ang optical-infrastructure spend beyond one supplier/material, pero pinapaalala rin na InP growth ≠ InP monopoly. Mas magandang thesis ngayon: ‘optical capacity cycle with multiple material winners,’ then let utilization and design wins decide who actually captures the economics. Hindi lahat ng rising boats iisang bangka.

sources.title: Soitec locks customers into multi-year deals as AI wafer demand surges

claims.text: Soitec is securing multi-year photonics-SOI wafer supply agreements with customer deposits/minimum-volume commitments and expects its photonics-SOI revenue base to rise from more than $100 million to about $200 million this financial year.
claims.basis: Reuters report based on Soitec CEO comments

claims.text: The Soitec evidence strengthens the broader AI optical-capacity-cycle thesis while weakening any interpretation that current capacity investment proves InP will dominate every optical architecture.
